title: Tara the Otter's Rainbow Bunting
markdown:
The air in Sunny Meadow Village felt buzzy with excitement. The Otter Festival was almost here. Bright flags danced from the shops and along the riverbank. Mayor Moss, a plump badger, fussed.

“Oh my,” he mumbled, “these flags must be perfectly straight.”

Suddenly Tara the otter zoomed past, a long coil of colourful bunting draped over her paws. “Don’t worry, Mayor Moss. I have a super-duper faster way.”

Mayor Moss blinked. “Faster? But it needs to be neat.”

Tara grinned. “Just watch.” With a big wiggle and a mighty pull, she tossed the whole string of bunting into the air. It did not hang straight. Instead it swooped and twirled like a happy rainbow, looping around the big oak tree and zig-zagging over the flowers. It looked like a cheerful hug around the whole village.

Kit the gull watched from a branch, the warm sun on his feathers. For a moment nobody spoke. The bunting breathed. The oak held it. The river winked.

“It looks like a happy rainbow taking a long nap,” Kit whispered.

Mayor Moss frowned. “A nap? The flags should be proper, not snoozing.” Tara’s grin drooped a little. “I just thought it would be faster… and pretty.”

Just then little rabbit children hopped into the square, giggling. “Wow,” they squealed. “The colours are dancing. It’s like a party in the sky.”

Mayor Moss watched the children’s happy faces. He looked at the bunting again, really seeing it. It wasn’t straight, but it was full of joy.

“You know, Kit,” he said, “maybe a rainbow does need a nap. And Tara,” he beamed at the otter, “your faster way has made our village square the most cheerful place ever. It’s like a happy song made of flags.”

Tara’s whiskers wiggled. “Really?”

“More than okay,” Mayor Moss declared, his voice warm. “It’s wonderful. The most magical bunting ever.”

And so the Otter Festival began, with a delightful dancing ribbon of colour that winked and shimmered in the sunshine. The village square hummed. The bunting, still not straight, kept on napping in the nicest possible way.
characters: Tara (a speedy festival otter), Kit (a branch-watching gull), Mayor Moss (a plump flag-fussing badger)
author: StoryGen Community
